name: Kurumsal Ağ Güvenliği ve Altyapı Planlaması
summary: A multinational organization with Istanbul, Ankara and London offices and a high-traffic academic branch of 10,000 students. Every site has an HA FortiGate pair on primary plus backup links, four VLAN roles (management, staff, student/guest, servers), default-deny rules, IPS and antivirus, and a central SIEM with SOC shifts.

remoteAccess.note: Secure VPN tunnels between sites; the London office has dedicated rule sets for international coordination.

monitoring.siem: All FortiGate logs go to a central SIEM via syslog; SNMPv3 with Zabbix/Grafana for CPU, RAM, interface and bandwidth.
monitoring.owner: SOC analysts on 24/7 shifts under a RACI matrix that names who is informed and who responds.
monitoring.alertSink: Automatic e-mail and SMS to the IT security team (bandwidth over 85% or a critical firewall rule hit).
monitoring.appVsSecurity: Sysadmin dashboards (Zabbix/Grafana) track device and bandwidth health; SIEM/SOC handles security events.
